# Coverage inventory — every command this project's automated stages and the
# CLAUDE.md gate sequence issue. Validated against .claude/settings.json by
# tools/allowlist_lint.py --coverage.
#
# Format:  <Tool>: <command>
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.
#
# EXTENSION POINT: the headless driver (#438) appends its commands here as
# they become real. The five factory stages (#437) are covered below.
#
# NOT CHECKED — machine tier. These are covered by ~/.claude/settings.json
# (template: .claude/settings.user.example.json), which this check does not
# read because its paths are placeholders:
#   Bash: java -jar <EMULICIOUS_JAR> build/nuke-raider.gb
#   Bash: <GBDK_HOME>/bin/romusage build/nuke-raider.gb

# --- worktree setup and sync ---
Bash: git fetch origin
Bash: git merge origin/master
Bash: git worktree list
Bash: git rev-parse --show-toplevel
Bash: git branch --show-current

# --- build and verification gates ---
Bash: make clean
Bash: make
Bash: make test
Bash: make test-tools
Bash: make memory-check
Bash: make bank-post-build
Bash: python tools/bank_check.py .
Bash: python tools/memory_check.py .
Bash: python tools/allowlist_lint.py

# --- inspection ---
Bash: git status
Bash: git diff origin/master...HEAD --stat
Bash: git log --oneline -5
Bash: git ls-files .claude
Bash: grep -n settings.local.json CLAUDE.md
Bash: ls tools

# --- issue and PR traffic ---
Bash: gh auth setup-git
Bash: gh issue view 443 --json title,body,state
Bash: gh pr create --title Title --body-file body.md
Bash: gh pr list --state open
Bash: gh run list --limit 5

# --- run publication (#472) ---
Bash: gh label create log --color 5319E7
Bash: gh release view factory-logs
Bash: gh release create factory-logs --title Title --notes Notes
Bash: gh release upload factory-logs asset.log
Bash: gh issue create --title Title --body-file body.md --label log
Bash: gh issue edit 481 --title Title --body-file body.md
Bash: gh issue reopen 481
Bash: gh issue close 481
Bash: gh issue comment 437 --body-file body.md
Bash: gh project item-add 3 --owner MatthieuGagne --url URL
Bash: gh project field-list 3 --owner MatthieuGagne --format json
Bash: gh project item-edit --id ID --project-id ID --field-id ID
Bash: python tools/factory_publish.py --issue 437 --stage-completed BUILD
PowerShell: python tools/factory_publish.py --issue 437 --terminal

# --- commits and push ---
# Tool choice is free: #441 moved the clean build to a pre-push repository
# hook, which fires for every actor, so no tool skips a gate.
PowerShell: git add -A
PowerShell: git commit -m message
PowerShell: git push -u origin feature-branch
PowerShell: make clean
PowerShell: make
PowerShell: make test-tools
PowerShell: gh pr create --title Title --body-file body.md
PowerShell: Start-Process -FilePath java -ArgumentList -jar

# --- factory stages (#437) ---
Bash: python tools/spec_lint.py --issue 461 --json
Bash: python tools/factory_event.py --issue 461 --kind stage
Bash: python tools/factory_cache.py
Bash: python tools/factory_log.py --stage VERIFY --issue 461
Bash: python tools/factory_report.py --issue 461 --out body.md
Bash: python tools/factory_status.py --json
Bash: python tools/smoketest_headless.py --scenario generic-smoke --json
Bash: python tools/trace.py --check --plans-only
Bash: git worktree add .claude/worktrees/factory-issue-461 -b factory-issue-461
Bash: git push -u origin factory-issue-461
PowerShell: python tools/factory_event.py --issue 461 --kind decision
PowerShell: python tools/factory_cache.py
Bash: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'tools'); import factory_run; print(factory_run.preserve_workspace(461))"
